test_title: PYST 30: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 21 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Sapna invested ₹21,700 on simple interest, partly at 3% per annum and partly at 12% per annum. If she earns equal interests from the two investments after 7 years, then find the sum invested at 3% per annum (in ₹).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When Simple Interest and Time are equal for two investments, the principal ratio is inversely proportional to the rates.

Ratio of parts (P₁ : P₂) = R₂ : R₁ = 12 : 3 = 4 : 1

Total units = 4 + 1 = 5 units.

Since 5 units = ₹21,700, then 1 unit = ₹4,340.

Sum invested at 3% (P₁) = 4 units = 4 × ₹4,340 = ₹17,360.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹17,360.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 Total Investment = ₹21,700
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 Part 1 (P₁)
 Rate = 3%, Time = 7 yr
 Interest = SI₁

 
 Part 2 (P₂)
 Rate = 12%, Time = 7 yr
 Interest = SI₂
 
 Condition: SI₁ = SI₂

**Given:**

Total Investment = ₹21,700

Rate 1 (R₁) = 3% p.a., Rate 2 (R₂) = 12% p.a.

Time (T) = 7 years for both parts

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

Let the amount invested at 3% be P₁ and at 12% be P₂.

⇒ P₁ + P₂ = 21700

Given that the simple interest earned from both investments after 7 years is equal:

⇒ (P₁ × 3 × 7) ÷ 100 = (P₂ × 12 × 7) ÷ 100

⇒ 21 × P₁ = 84 × P₂

⇒ P₁ ÷ P₂ = 84 ÷ 21 = 4 ÷ 1

⇒ Total ratio parts = 4 + 1 = 5 units

⇒ 5 units = ₹21,700

⇒ 1 unit = 21700 ÷ 5 = 4340

⇒ Sum invested at 3% = 4 units

⇒ 4 units = 4 × 4340 = 17360

**∴ The correct answer is ₹17,360.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equal Simple Interest Rule

If a certain sum is divided into multiple parts such that their simple interests are equal, the ratio of the divided principals is 1/(R₁T₁) : 1/(R₂T₂) : 1/(R₃T₃).

Equal Amount Rule

If a sum is divided into multiple parts such that the total amount (Principal + SI) from each part is equal, the principal ratio is 1/(100 + R₁T₁) : 1/(100 + R₂T₂).

Effective Simple Interest

The overall accumulated simple interest percentage over T years is simply R × T %. The total SI amount is calculated directly as (R × T)% of the Principal.
